of816.scope: Pinned Forth core for the experimental AltirraOS XEX boot monitor

result.scope: Desktop OF816 autoboot, independent client input/drag/focus, disk commands, seven-Task pipeline and EXIT

scope: Exact packaged OF816 XEX and matching ATR/ROM, PAL 65C816 x8, 4 MiB, VBXE FX1.26 D600/512 KiB, physical ST mouse port 1 and keyboard. Five-second autoboot observed at 249 frame boundaries.

Seventeen full-scene scanout comparisons: initial desktop, independent app key, grid-aligned drag, shell focus, TASKS, mounted volume/navigation, physical disk HELLO, shared-cache TYPE and CAT/WC pipeline, final prompt.

Five Tasks at the prompt, seven live Tasks observed during the two-command pipeline; no primes. Both clients drain on shell EXIT, zero remaining live Tasks, guards/DP/native return and ownership checks pass.
The oracle recomposes from retained geometry/content without reading target cached visibility/damage. DT5 provides the separate hard-coded two-client scene oracle.

The source banner is 1db8318-dirty: final DT7 build/package changes plus unrelated pre-existing cartridge work were present. Manifest source hashes record the actual inputs; cartridge work is excluded from desktop commits.
Distribution contains fourteen boot/media/guide/notice/checksum files only. Intermediates/manifests/traces remain outside ZIP. The default shell/prime selection and OF816 countdown remain unchanged.
Local preview only; no GitHub publication or physical-device/whole-system qualification. Pointer/outline, loaded disk-button and move-repair targets remain open.
